# hetznerrobot_subnet_cancellation (Resource)

Cancels a subnet. Destroying this resource withdraws a pending cancellation; one cancelled `now` is gone immediately. Every argument forces a new cancellation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hetznerrobot_subnet_cancellation" "legacy" {
  ip                = "178.63.123.120"
  cancellation_date = "2026-12-31"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cancellation_date` (String) Date the subnet should be cancelled to (`yyyy-MM-dd`), or `now` to cancel immediately. See `earliest_cancellation_date` of the data source for the earliest possible date.
- `ip` (String) The subnet to cancel (for a subnet: its net address).

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the cancellation is active.
- `earliest_cancellation_date` (String) Earliest possible cancellation date.
- `effective_date` (String) Cancellation date as Robot holds it — the actual date for `now`.
- `mask` (String) Prefix length of the subnet.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the subnet belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_subnet_cancellation.legacy 178.63.123.120
```
